PART III - LANDS

FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 81 (Ampara) Where as a settlement notice under Section 4 of the Land Settlement Ordinance was duly published in the Gazette No. 419 of 12th Sep-tember 1986, and as otherwise required by the said Section, in respect of the lands situated in the village of Pradhana Pradeshaya in the Padiyathalawa Assistant Government Agent’s Division (now Padiyathalawa Divisional Secretary's Division) of Ampara District in the Eastern Province and described as Lot no. 01 in Topo preliminary Plan No. 52 (East) (Vide Settlement Notice No. 5417 (Ampara). And whereas all claims received in pursuance of the said notice have been duly dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordinance: I, the undersigned, in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by Section 5(5) of the said Ordinance do hereby make order that the lands or portions thereof be settled as specified in the Schedule to this order. P.M.H.PRIYADHARSHANI, Assistant Settlement Officer Commissioner of - Land Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla 15th September, 2014.
